# AUTO-GENERATED wire-format snapshot -- do not hand-edit.
# Regenerate with: tools/protocol-snapshot.py --write
# One line per network command: <spec-order> <enum> [flags] : <field-types-in-order>,
# a struct expanded as Struct<Name>{members} and an array as Array<Byte>{element};
# then the hand-framed commands, whose fields their own senders write rather than the spec,
# with ? for a conditional field and * for one written in a loop;
# then one line per wire command id: <value> <enum>, as network_enums.h assigns it.
# A diff here means a backport changed the client/server wire format. Confirm it
# is intentional AND that older clients can still parse it before updating this file.
